journey.name: Media Player Playback
journey.description: Tests playing a downloaded video or audio file using the built-in ExoPlayer and MiniPlayer controls.

actions.action: Ensure the app is on the My Files screen with at least one completed download
Verify that the built-in media player launches
Verify that the video starts playing and playback controls (play/pause, seek bar, time display) are functional
Tap the close or back button on the player
Verify that the player closes and the persistent MiniPlayer bar appears at the bottom if audio is active
